stock.description: Q Technology (Group) Company Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise, primarily focused on the global research, development, design, manufacturing, and distribution of camera and fingerprint identification modules. These components are tailored for integration into mobile phones and various intelligent mobile terminals, serving markets both within the People's Republic of China and internationally. Its extensive product portfolio includes a range of camera modules, such as high-end, mid-range, multi-lens, optical image stabilization (OIS), automotive-grade, smart home, and 3D versions. Additionally, the company provides both capacitive and optical under-screen fingerprint sensors. These advanced components find applications across diverse sectors, including prominent smartphone brands, tablet computers, Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and intelligent vehicles. Beyond its core production, the firm also engages in the trading of these camera and fingerprint recognition modules. Established in 2007, its corporate headquarters are situated in Kunshan, People's Republic of China, and it functions as a subsidiary of Q Technology Investment Inc.
